title: DIL THAAM KAY YEH KUBRA NEY KAHAA
body:
DIL THAAM KAY YEH KUBRA NEY KAHAA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
BATHLAAO MUJHEY QASIM DULHA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
<<DIVIDER>>
MUNH MODD KAY TUM KO JAANA THA
GAR CHODD KAY MUJHKO JAANA THA
KYUN HAATH MERA THAAMA THA BHALAA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
<<DIVIDER>>
RAAS AAYI NA BACHPAN KI SHAADI
DEKHO TOH MERI YEH BARBAADI
KIS JURM KI PAAYI MAINEY SAZAA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
<<DIVIDER>>
SHAADI THI MERI KYA KHOOB RACHI
SAB MUJHKO DULHAN KEHTAY THAY ABHI
AUR KEHTAY HAIN AB MUJHKO BEVAA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
<<DIVIDER>>
CHUPP KIS LIYE HO BOLO QAASIM
BAAZU SEY RASAN KHOLO QAASIM
HOTHI HAI BAHOTH MUJHKO IZZA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
<<DIVIDER>>
AB KAUN KAREY IMDAAD MERI
AB KAUN SUNAAYE FARYAAD MERI
KOYI BHI NAHIN SUNNAY WALAA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
<<DIVIDER>>
MANZAR THA QAYAMATH KA WOH NAZAR
PHATT-TAA THA HAR EK KA GHAM SEY JIGAR
RO RO KAY JO KEHTI THI KUBRA
KYUN MUJHKO AKEILAA CHODD CHALEY
